sp at the start is shp; ie is ee; the ending -el is uhl. Stress on the first syllable.
st at the start is sht; the final d sounds t. One syllable.
z is ts; the doubled o is a long oh. One syllable.
w is v; the u before two consonants is short. One syllable.
z is ts and w is v, so zw is tsv; ie is ee; the ending -el is uhl. Stress on the first syllable.
ch after r is the soft hh; the final e is said, uh. Stress on Kir.
i before a doubled l is short; the final e is said. Stress on the first syllable.
sch is sh; the h after u is silent and makes it long. One syllable.
ei is ai, as in eye. One syllable.
ä is eh, ck is k, ei is ai. The ending -ei is always stressed: behk-uh-RAI.
Fuß + Ball (foot + ball). ß after the long u is s; a is short before ll. Stress on the first part.
Bahn + Hof (railway + yard). The h after a is silent and makes it long. Stress on Bahn.
Fahr + Rad (ride + wheel). The h makes the a long; the final d sounds t. Stress on Fahr.
Hand + Schuh (hand + shoe). The d ends the first part, so it sounds t; sch is sh. Stress on Hand.
Flug + Zeug (flight + thing). The g ending each part sounds k; z is ts; eu is oy. Stress on Flug.
Straßen + Bahn (streets + railway). st at the start is sht; ß is s. Stress on the first part.
Haus + Aufgabe (home + task). au is ow, twice; the final e is said. Stress on Haus.
